# LinkButton

A text link button: accent-colored text without background or underline, with the font size of its context.
Use it for actions in table rows (edit, archive), clickable names in lists and "View" on cards.

Compared with Button: `type="text"` on Button is a neutral text button (a background appears on hover) that
suits toolbars; LinkButton is accent-colored text for actions that appear next to body text or table content.
Button does not offer antd's `type="link"`; all accent-colored text actions use LinkButton.

**Interaction**: the text darkens on hover and darkens further immediately on press (recovering 120 ms after
release), without scaling or a background; the click area extends 4 px beyond the text on every side; `Tab`
focus shows the focus ring, and `Enter` / `Space` trigger the button; when disabled, the opacity is lowered,
and with `disabledReason` the reason is shown on hover or focus.

**Category**: Basic · **Common uses**: Edit, archive and remove in table rows; clickable names in lists; "View" and "Pin" on cards

## Import

```ts
import { LinkButton } from 'vellum-ui'
```

## Basic usage

Accent-colored text without background or underline; the font size follows its context. Use it for edit and
archive actions in table rows and for "View" on cards.

```tsx
import { useState } from 'react'
import { Inline, LinkButton, Stack, Text } from 'vellum-ui'

export function Basic() {
  const [count, setCount] = useState(0)
  return (
    <Stack gap={3}>
      <Inline gap={4}>
        <LinkButton onClick={() => setCount((n) => n + 1)}>Edit</LinkButton>
        <LinkButton>Archive</LinkButton>
        <LinkButton icon="external-link">View details</LinkButton>
      </Inline>
      <Text tone="secondary" size="sm">
        "Edit" clicked {count} times
      </Text>
    </Stack>
  )
}
```

## Variants

### Clickable name

A name in a list that opens its details: it does not stand out awkwardly in running text, and its click area
extends 4 px beyond the text on each side.

```tsx
import { LinkButton, Text } from 'vellum-ui'

export function InlineName() {
  return (
    <Text>
      The document <LinkButton>Annual report</LinkButton> has been updated.
    </Text>
  )
}
```

### Destructive actions

Use `tone="danger"` for destructive actions in a row, such as removing or revoking access; irreversible actions
still need a confirmation (Popconfirm or useConfirmDanger).

```tsx
import { Inline, LinkButton } from 'vellum-ui'

export function Danger() {
  return (
    <Inline gap={4}>
      <LinkButton tone="danger">Remove</LinkButton>
      <LinkButton tone="danger" icon="alert">
        Failed to send. Retry
      </LinkButton>
    </Inline>
  )
}
```

## States

### Disabled and disabled reason

When a button is disabled because of permissions or unmet conditions, explain why with `disabledReason`: it
appears on hover or keyboard focus, and screen readers read it too.

```tsx
import { Inline, LinkButton } from 'vellum-ui'

export function Disabled() {
  return (
    <Inline gap={4}>
      <LinkButton disabled>Archive</LinkButton>
      <LinkButton
        disabled
        disabledReason="A project needs at least one owner, so this member cannot be removed"
      >
        Remove
      </LinkButton>
    </Inline>
  )
}
```

## Props

| Prop | Type | Description | Default | Required |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `children` | `ReactNode` | Button text. | — | Yes |
| `tone` | `'accent' \| 'danger'` | Tone: `accent` (default); `danger` for destructive inline actions such as removing an item or revoking access. | `'accent'` | No |
| `icon` | `IconName` | Icon before the text. | — | No |
| `disabledReason` | `string` | Disabled reason: an explanation shown on hover or keyboard focus while `disabled` (as on Button). With a reason, the button can still be focused with `Tab` (`aria-disabled`), screen readers read the reason through `aria-describedby`, and clicks and `Enter` have no effect. | — | No |

Also accepts the attributes of the native element (`ButtonHTMLAttributes`), such as `disabled` and `onClick`.

Does not accept `style` or `className`: appearance is adjusted only through the semantic props above and the theme.

## Types

Types of this library used above. Import them with `import type { … } from 'vellum-ui'`.

### IconName

Name of a registered icon. Only the icons listed here can be used; they are Lucide icons under shorter names
(`trash` is Lucide's `Trash2`, `more` is `Ellipsis`). All names at runtime: `iconNames`.

126 values, listed on the [Icon](Icon.md#types) page.
